name: Composite → RF (VHF/UHF modulation)
description: Third stage: FM-modulate the composite baseband signal onto a VHF or UHF carrier for antenna transmission or cable distribution. Also covers VHS's internal RF down-conversion for the chroma channel.

stages.name: FM Video Modulation
stages.description: Frequency-modulate the composite signal onto the video carrier. Sync tip = carrier rest frequency; peak white = peak deviation.

stages.name: VHS Chroma Down-Conversion
stages.description: VHS cannot record the 3.58 MHz chroma subcarrier at full speed — its luma FM system occupies most of the bandwidth. Instead, chroma is down-converted to a low-bandwidth FM carrier at ~629 kHz before recording.
stages.note: This is the primary cause of VHS colour degradation. The down-converted carrier is FM-modulated with the chroma information at reduced bandwidth.

stages.name: RF Noise Floor
stages.description: Thermal noise from the tuner adds ~12–18 dB SNR degradation at the antenna input.
